mechanism_log: The system has a clean causal structure: Y1 is driven positively by ALL 6 inputs (X6 and X3 strongest). Y2 is driven negatively by X4, X2, X1 and positively by X5, X3, X6. Y3 is controlled EXCLUSIVELY by X1 and X4 (all other inputs have exactly zero effect). Y4 is driven primarily by X3, then X6 and X2, with X5 having a small negative effect. X4 has zero effect on Y4. Y1 and Y2 conflict (many inputs push both up), and Y4 vs Y2 conflicts via X3 and X5. The Y3≥0.4 constraint requires sufficient X1 and/or X4. Nonlinearity detected in X1→Y3 (saturates at high X1).
